ns2:course.label: Pathobiology I
ns2:course.description: Teaches principles of pharmacology; general pathology; immunology; medical genetics; and mechanistic toxicology. 0 or 9.5 hours. Prerequisite: VM 604 and good standing in the veterinary professional curriculum, or consent of instructor.
